topology.build_container: registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44; alsa-topology-utils, cmake, make, gcc, gcc-c++

selection.selector: kernel request_firmware sound-model contract; no early selector service

software_policy.initial_mute: The later global sink default is 0.0, overriding the 0.05 hardware fallback. The helper verifies mute before setting 5% for sp11.audio_first_test=1 or sp11.entry=spk, or 100% normally. Runtime confirmation is mandatory.
software_policy.enforcement: Kernel caps D26/open-loop PA at 6 (0 dB) and WSA RX/MIX at 81 (-3 dB); UCM sets the digital boot value to 72 (-12 dB). The closed-loop SP+VI mode caps PA at 17 (+16.5 dB) and WSA RX/MIX at 84 (0 dB). sp11-audio-safety raises the four digital controls to 84 only on the sp11.allow_nominal=1 entry (the same marker the V/I sense service uses), excluding sp11.nospk, sp11.entry=spk and sp11.audio_first_test=1; the kernel platform_max (the authority) rejects the same write on D26/open-loop, so a marker on a wrong entry cannot raise that ceiling. The PA follows the "Speakers Volume" remap; a 100% sink is expected to reach the kernel cap (device confirmation pending). Pro Audio is disabled; the helper verifies mute before setting the startup level.

build_gate.private_runtime_state: unvalidated; private ISO is operator-only and must never be shared
build_gate.purpose: Public builds require full D28 runtime safety evidence; private operator-only builds may proceed with pinned source and topology while runtime validation is pending.
